forecast_reason: Two times the 43.481-second pooled median valid nonbaseline cycle interval from the old development campaign, fixed before this campaign.

methods.ilr_history: Frozen nearest-history rule on complete CPU/RAM ILR prefixes and common service features.
methods.share_history: Same frozen nearest-history rule on complete raw CPU/RAM share prefixes and common service features.
methods.prometheus_predict_linear: Native Prometheus linear forecasts of the four raw requirement gauges; warning is their unsafe OR.

comparison_unit: First-violation history for detection; runner history and decision counts for false signals. Decision windows are dependent.
missingness: A Prometheus forecast needs at least two finite samples for every gauge. Unavailable forecasts are not silence; common-coverage comparisons remove the same decisions from all methods. Failed or baseline-unsafe jobs are retained, never replaced.
interpretation: This prospectively evaluates two whole resource-history observers against one fixed practical service-trend rule. It separately diagnoses ILR versus shares. It does not attribute any whole-rule difference solely to geometry.
